title: urtica dioica var. umbrosa
intro: Urtica dioica var. umbrosa, commonly known as the lesser nettle or French nettle, is a variant of the stinging nettle plant, characterized by its smaller leaves and more compact growth habit compared to the common nettle. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Urtica dioica var. umbrosa include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and diuretic, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
